name: stamp
description: A rubber-stamp or edition mark: wide-tracked capitals in a double rule, set at a slight angle. For "Sold out", "Look 07", "No. 0417", "Limited edition" — in a default, primary, destructive or success ink, three sizes, as a rectangle or a round seal. Pure CSS; the mark is real text.

shape.description: rect is a framed label that is as wide as its text; round is a circular seal, a fixed 8em disc per size, with the text wrapping and balancing inside it.

--stamp-rotate.description: The angle the mark is pressed at (custom property). Any angle; 0deg sets it straight, a positive angle leans it the other way.

a11y.notes: A stamp is real text in a span with no role: it is read as written, in the document's reading order, and the capitals are text-transform so the source keeps its own case. The rotation is visual only. When a stamp carries status (Sold out, Cancelled) say it in words, as the text does; never rely on the ink colour alone, because destructive and success are colour cues. A stamp that only repeats a status stated beside it may be hidden from assistive technology with aria-hidden="true" so it is not read twice. Keep a round seal's text short: it is a fixed disc, and long words break rather than overflow.
